# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] aegis-analytics: Aegis Analytics AI`
>
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/aegis-analytics/`

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** Aegis Analytics AI
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/aegis-analytics/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** Enterprise quantitative market intelligence, calibrated machine learning forecasting, and Web3 cryptographic verification platform powered by an end-to-end IBM Db2 AI Toolkit.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** Solves uncalibrated confidence and unquantified downside tail risk in algorithmic finance, while bridging enterprise IBM Db2 storage with modern AI agent frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Haystack). Target audience: quantitative hedge funds, enterprise risk analysts, and database administrators.

---

## 2. Team Information

- **Team Name:** Aegis Systems
- **Team Members:**

| Full Name | GitHub Username | Email / Role |
|---|---|---|
| Udit Rajput | @Uditrajput09 | uditrajput609@gmail.com / Lead Quantitative Developer |

---

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 LUW (Docker Community Edition `icr.io/db2_community/db2:latest` / IBM Cloud Db2) with Zero-Docker Mock Sandbox fallback (`DB2_MOCK_FALLBACK=true`).
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** Serves as the high-throughput time-series store for market bars, in-database ELT transformation engine via dbt, and knowledge retrieval store for autonomous Text-to-SQL agents and vector embeddings.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** Native `ibm_db`, SQLAlchemy `ibm_db_sa`, SQLGlot cross-dialect transpiler, `ibm-dbt-db2`, LangChain `SQLDatabase` agent, CrewAI custom Db2 tools, LlamaIndex vector store, Deepset Haystack 2.x DocumentStore, and Langflow visual flow builder (`lfx-ibm`).
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:** `MARKET_BARS` (OHLCV prices), `ML_PREDICTIONS` (dual-head forecasts and conformal bounds), `RISK_METRICS` (in-database dbt marts), and `DB2_VECTOR_DOCUMENTS` (semantic financial research embeddings).
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:** Run `python tests/test_db2_toolkit.py` inside `submissions/aegis-analytics/` to execute all 10 automated test suites verifying connection management, SQL transpilation, dbt models, LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Langflow, and FastAPI REST endpoints.

---

## 4. Technology Stack & AI / LLM Usage

- **Programming Languages:** Python, TypeScript, Solidity, SQL
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** FastAPI, React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, Recharts, Streamlit, Plotly, LightGBM, Web3.py, Hardhat
- **AI / LLM Framework (if applicable):** LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Deepset Haystack 2.x, Langflow
- **Model Provider & Model Name (if applicable):** Google Gemini 3.5 Flash (`gemini-3.5-flash`), LightGBM Dual-Head (Regression & Isotonic Classification), and Distribution-Free Conformal Prediction Bounds
- **Where AI/LLM is Applied in the Workflow:** Dual-head LightGBM models forecast price returns and directional probability with isotonic probability calibration and non-parametric conformal risk intervals (90% coverage). Google Gemini 3.5 Flash acts as an institutional financial copilot translating live telemetry into natural language briefings.

---

## 5. Demonstration & Links

- **Live Demo URL (if hosted):** https://github.com/Uditrajput09/aegis-analytics-ai-system
- **Demo Video (YouTube / Loom / Drive):** N/A
- **External Source Repo (if hosted separately):** https://github.com/Uditrajput09/aegis-analytics-ai-system
- **Presentation / Slides URL (optional):** Included in repository documentation

---

## 6. Submission Verification Checklist

- [x] **Folder Structure:** My submission is placed in a single new directory under `submissions/aegis-analytics/` copied from `submissions/_template/`.
- [x] **Naming Conventions:** The `aegis-analytics` slug uses lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, matching the branch name and PR title.
- [x] **Complete Documentation:** Both `submissions/aegis-analytics/README.md` and `submissions/aegis-analytics/architecture.md` are completely filled out without unfilled placeholder markers.
- [x] **Metadata File:** `submissions/aegis-analytics/submission.json` is completed and valid JSON.
- [x] **No Secrets or Credentials:** No API keys, passwords, private tokens, or connection strings with real credentials are committed. `.env.example` contains placeholders only.
- [x] **Tested Setup Instructions:** Setup and run instructions were tested from a fresh environment and can be reproduced by reviewers (`scripts/validate_submission.py` passed).
- [x] **License Declared:** MIT License declared in repository.
- [x] **Code of Conduct:** All team members agree to adhere to the repository [Code of Conduct](../../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [x] **Scope Isolation:** This PR only adds/modifies files inside `submissions/aegis-analytics/` and does not touch root files or other submissions.
- [x] **Google Form Submission:** I understand that opening this PR is step 1, and I will submit this PR URL into the official Google Form.

---

## 7. Additional Notes for Reviewers & Judges

- Zero-Docker verification: Evaluators can run the full test suite (`python tests/test_db2_toolkit.py`) out of the box without provisioning containers, as the mock sandbox automatically mirrors real Db2 LUW catalogs and table operations when an active server is offline.
